contexts.text: Go to the land of Moriah () = a place and state of temptation... That the land of Moriah = a place of temptation, is evident from the fact that Abraham was commanded to go thither, and to offer his son there for a burnt-offering, and thus to undergo the last of temptation. That Jerusalem, where the Lord Himself endured the last of temptation, was in that land, is evident from the fact that on mount Moriah the altar was built by David, and afterwards the Temple by Solomon (). Compare  with . AC 2777.
